# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.

## Healthcare solutions for modern day Heroes

[Woman doctor and a mobile flying ambulan]

Estill Medical Technologies is an innovative solutions-driven company, developing and manufacturing
patient temperature management and medical energy solutions.  The leading device produced by Estill,
is the portable Thermal Angel Blood and IV Fluid Infusion warmer (TA-200) powered by our compact yet
rugged military grade battery (UB-1) allowing for warming care to be given in the field immediately
to the patient. We proudly serve the emergency medical community, first responders, military,
government, and university researchers.   Let us know what we can do for you today.

# Insurance and Benefits
# **

International health insurance for Individuals and Employers.
Find the right plan for you below:

## **International Health Insurance for you and your family**

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.
[ INTERNATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE (12+ MONTHS) ][106]
[ SHORT TERM HEALTH INSURANCE (3-9 MONTHS) ][107]
[Young women smiling at camera]

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.
[ GET A QUOTE ][108]
[Two people working together on a tablet]

## **International Health Insurance Services included with your cover**

You have access to a range of services gathered in one convenient hub to help protect you and your
family from preventable health risks. Our services include Telehealth Hub, Expat Assistance
programme, Fitness coaching App, Nutrition Hub, Travel Security and more.

# Saving Lives.
# Together.

On the front lines of critical care, everything matters. Lives depend upon us—all of us bringing our
best. Our innovative medical devices help you deliver. Belmont’s solutions blend technical
inspiration with an uncompromising quality standard. Because earning your trust is the only option.

When lives are in your hands, reach for Belmont.

## At our best when it matters most.

In developing and refining our leading fluid warming and temperature regulation devices, we strive
to innovate advanced capabilities and patient safety features that give you the power and precision
to change the course of critical outcomes.
* [ BLOOD & FLUID WARMING ][31]
* [ TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT ][32]
* [ HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE ][33]

BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### The Belmont^{®} Rapid Infuser RI-2

Trusted in the most extreme situations for more than 20 years, The Belmont® Rapid Infuser delivers
rapid, reliable, and bubble-free delivery of life-saving warmed blood and fluid at the touch of a
button.
* Precise control of fluid delivery (at rates from 2.5 to 1000 ml per minute)
* Precise, high-speed warming
* Automatic air detection and removal
* Intuitive touchscreen display
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][34]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### buddy lite^{®}

Portable blood and fluid warming—anytime, anywhere—in a remarkably compact, lightweight package,
buddy lite^{®} is used globally by clinicians to help prevent hypothermia during fluid
administration.
* Easy to use
* Close-to-patient warming
* Battery or AC powered
* Military tested and approved
* Aluminum-free disposable

[LEARN MORE][35]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### BloodNav^{™}

MTP Performance Improvement & Automatic Documentation Tool
* Rapidly tracks blood products across all locations
* Calculates ratios to support balanced transfusion goals
* Displays customizable MTP performance improvement prompts
* Provides live web dashboard for blood bank
* Streamlines documentation & integrates with EMRs

[LEARN MORE][36]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### Burn Navigator^{®}

Evidence-based fluid management for severely burned adults and children
* Unique resuscitation graphs
* 24-hour volume projections
* Non-responder detection and alerts
* Customizable protocols
* Inhalation injury guidelines
* EMR connectivity

[LEARN MORE][37]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### Allon^{®}

Safe, simple, and effective, this non-invasive system maintains patient body temperature throughout
all stages of the perioperative continuum. Allon’s algorithm-driven heat pump circulates water
through the ThermoWrap^{®} disposable patient garment.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy-to-use touch-screen interface
* Real-time monitoring and graphical display
* Full range of sizes and configurations

 

[LEARN MORE][38]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### CritiCool^{®}

Maintaining pre-set, targeted body temperature as determined by a physician, this safe, and
effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][40]

## Areas of Care

In every area of care, better products result in better outcomes. Patients, their advocates, and
your own people expect the best from you. Belmont solutions blend technical inspiration with
uncompromising quality to give your clinicians added power to affect the course of medical events.
That’s the goal we all share.

effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

## WHO ARE WE?

At Croyde Medical, our mission and vision statements guide how we work every day. They reflect who
we are, what we stand for, and the future we are building together with our customers, partners, and
colleagues.

## Our Mission

We specialise in maternity, neonatal, and temperature management equipment solutions, helping
healthcare teams create exceptional environments to deliver safe, effective, and compassionate care.
Our customers trust us to deliver our promise with support from our field-based specialists and
dedicated customer service team.

## Our Vision

To be the partner of choice for maternity, neonatal, and temperature management equipment. We will
expand our portfolio with clear purpose through innovation and meaningful partnerships, while
building a trusted, responsible brand where our people thrive, our customers feel supported, and we
enjoy the journey together.

## OUR VALUES

Our core values guide us in our mission of helping transform clinical environments. They remind us
of why we started, keep us focused on our goals, and inspire us to continue to help our customers.

[Values Image]

### EXCELLENCE

We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do.

### MAKING A DIFFERENCE

Our products and services make a real difference to healthcare teams and those they care for.

### CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

We constantly evolve, learn, and improve to deliver better outcomes and solutions.

### AGILITY

We are responsive and adaptable, reacting quickly to our customers' needs.

### TRUST FIRST

We build long-lasting, trusted relationships with our suppliers, partners and customers.

## YOU'RE SAFE IN OUR HANDS

Croyde Medical is a NHSSC framework approved supplier and has been trading with the NHS for 10
years.

We are also an ISO 9001 accredited organisation, which means we adhere to the highest standards of
quality management. This accreditation gives our customers the confidence to work with us, knowing
that they will receive reliable, top-notch service and products that meet stringent industry
standards.

## CROYDE MEDICAL ACQUIRES QED SCIENTIFIC LTD

Croyde Medical welcomes QED Scientific Ltd to the family! 

QED Scientific was founded in 1997 by Iain and Gill Jaundrell-Thompson.

QED Scientific offer a range of maternity and neonatal equipment, patient warming and cooling
systems and manufacture high-quality warming and controlled room temperature (CRT) cabinets.

This acquisition, combined with Croyde's extensive portfolio, will bring even greater choice and
value to our customers.

## Our mission is
## every parent’s mission

We are a charity on a mission to reduce the incidence and
impact of a child’s critical injury.

With your support, we have **already contributed nearly
$2,000,000 worth of research**
to determine how to do that.

Our campaigns respond directly to recommendations
from this research.  That’s why we know they’ll work.

### We’re raising funds for families.

Help us raise $100,000 to pay for two specialist professionals to care directly
for families at Lady Cilento Children’s Hospital in Brisbane.

[Fundraise][30]

### Reducing the impact

When a child is suddenly critically injured, worlds are turned upside down in shock and panic.
 We’ve discovered two direct support roles in hospital will significantly reduce the impact of a
child’s critical injury.

The Day of Difference Foundation is now funding these two roles at Lady Cilento Children’s Hospital.

[Learn More][31]

### Reducing the Incidence

We have to radically reduce the staggering numbers of children’s injuries in Australia.  More
children are hospitalised with an injury in Australia than diabetes, asthma and cancer combined.

Our partnerships use the information we’ve gathered through research to begin to make a dent in
these numbers.

[Learn More][32]

## Our mission is
## every parent’s mission

We are a charity on a mission to reduce the incidence and
impact of a child’s critical injury.

With your support, we have **already contributed nearly
$2,000,000 worth of research**
to determine how to do that.

Our campaigns respond directly to recommendations
from this research.  That’s why we know they’ll work.

### We’re raising funds for families.

Help us raise $100,000 to pay for two specialist professionals to care directly
for families at Lady Cilento Children’s Hospital in Brisbane.

[Fundraise][30]

### Reducing the impact

When a child is suddenly critically injured, worlds are turned upside down in shock and panic.
 We’ve discovered two direct support roles in hospital will significantly reduce the impact of a
child’s critical injury.

The Day of Difference Foundation is now funding these two roles at Lady Cilento Children’s Hospital.

[Learn More][31]

### Reducing the Incidence

We have to radically reduce the staggering numbers of children’s injuries in Australia.  More
children are hospitalised with an injury in Australia than diabetes, asthma and cancer combined.

Our partnerships use the information we’ve gathered through research to begin to make a dent in
these numbers.

[Learn More][32]

### [Air-Free][80]

HotDog utilizes a unique **conductive fabric** called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat.
Forced-air warming systems have been shown to contaminate the air of the sterile field when their
waste heat carries foreign particles to the surgical site.

**[Learn More >][81]**

### [Better Warming][82]

Warm from **above** and **below** the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with

warming into a **two-in-one device**. This “game-changing solution” causes procedures to be set up
in less time, with better outcomes, for less cost.

**[Learn More >][87]**

## What is HotDog?

[HotDog Air-Free Patient Warming Logo]

HotDog’s reusable, air-free patient warming system maintains normothermia without forced-air risks
and waste. A central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming
devices.

HotDog Blankets and Mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems while also acting as a return electrode.

HotDog is the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and below
simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective warming
solution before, during, and after surgery.

### [Air-Free][80]

HotDog utilizes a unique **conductive fabric** called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat.
Forced-air warming systems have been shown to contaminate the air of the sterile field when their
waste heat carries foreign particles to the surgical site.

### [Better Warming][82]

Warm from **above** and **below** the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with

procedures.

### [Cost Effective][84]

Implement HotDog with **no up-front costs** and immediate cost savings. Decrease your cost of care.
Normothermic patients have better outcomes which lead to shorter hospital stays and faster operating
room turnover rates.

**[Learn More >][85]**

### [Return Electrode][86]

HotDog U5XX Warming Mattresses + Return Electrode combine electrosurgical grounding and underbody
warming into a **two-in-one device**. This “game-changing solution” causes procedures to be set up
in less time, with better outcomes, for less cost.

**[Learn More >][87]**

## What is HotDog?

[HotDog Air-Free Patient Warming Logo]

HotDog’s reusable, air-free patient warming system maintains normothermia without forced-air risks
and waste. A central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming
devices.

Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog Blankets and Mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems while also acting as a return electrode.

HotDog is the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and below
simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective warming
solution before, during, and after surgery.

Climbing the mountain of medical device development? Inventors, startups, and established companies
all face distinct development and regulatory challenges along the way. That’s where we come in.

With you every step of the way, or just over the hurdle to a critical milestone, it’s your choice.

# Welcome to Medbidding

Medbidding is a reliable shopping platform where secondhand medical products are sold. Thanks to
Medbidding, which brings buyers and sellers together, you can buy or sell medical products at the
prices you want.

Becoming a member, adding ads and bidding is free.

The Secure Payment System protects the rights of both parties by securing the buyer’s payment and
the seller’s product. No additional fees, full assurance.

## **Buy**

You can buy products at the prices you want.
* We provide price assurance. We do not allow unrealistic prices by checking ads. We try to keep
  prices within a reasonable range.
* We offer free technical expertise service. All products you purchase are checked and reported by
  our expert engineers before delivery.
* If you need, you can take advantage of our services such as transportation, installation, training
  and support, paid or free.
* With the Secure Payment System, we protect the rights of both buyers and sellers. Your money and
  property are safe. No additional fees, full assurance.

You can sell products at the prices you want.
* Medbidding is an international platform. In this way, sellers reach more potential customers.

  price suggestions

## We are Your UK Normothermia Experts

#### Air-Free

HotDog utilizes a unique conductive fabric called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat. Forced-air
warming systems contaminate the air of the sterile field when their waste heat carries particles to
the surgical site.

#### Better Warming

Warm from above and below the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with both
blankets and mattresses. This gives it tremendous versatility and effectiveness for many procedures.

#### Cost Effective

Implement HotDog with no up-front costs and immediate cost savings. Decrease your cost of care.
Normothermic patients have better outcomes which lead to shorter hospital stays and faster operating
room turnover rates.

## What is HotDog?

HotDog Patient Warming is an air-free, water-free, perioperative temperature management system. A
central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming devices.
Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog blankets and mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems. It’s the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and
below simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective
warming solution before, during, and after surgery.
[ Contact Us ][19]

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming?

#### Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the Operating Theatre

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilised, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.”

## Patient Warming UK – Sustainability Policy

At Patient Warming UK, sustainability is not just a commitment; it’s our guiding principle. We
prioritise environmental responsibility by integrating sustainable practices into every aspect of
our operations. From sourcing materials with minimal ecological impact to implementing
energy-efficient manufacturing processes, we strive to minimise our carbon footprint. Moreover, we
prioritise the well-being of our communities by supporting local initiatives and fostering a culture
of environmental stewardship among our employees. Through continuous innovation and collaboration,
we aim to create products that promote health, preserve resources, and contribute to a more
sustainable future for generations to come.

## What is HotDog?

HotDog Patient Warming is an air-free, water-free, perioperative temperature management system. A
central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming devices.
Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog blankets and mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems. It’s the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and
below simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective
warming solution before, during, and after surgery.

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming?

#### Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the Operating Theatre

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilised, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.”

[schmidt-firm-sign1]The Schmidt Firm PLLC has been recognized as one of the nation’s leading
plaintiff’s law firms and handles cases in all 50 states. The Firm, over the years, has handled many

trucking accidents, and wrongful death cases.

Attorney CL Mike Schmidt has been practicing law for 50 years.  Starting as a defense lawyer and

Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and Board Certified as Civil Trial Specialist
by the National Board of Trial Advocacy.

### A Diversified Practice

The Schmidt Firm, PLLC has focused its practice on the representation of plaintiffs involved in both
traditional personal injury and wrongful death litigation – involving medical malpractice,
transportation accidents and nursing home abuse – as well as mass tort and toxic tort litigation –
involving defective or dangerous pharmaceuticals, medical devices and toxic substances like Benzene
and Asbestos. The Firm has also handled a large number of business cases, for both plaintiffs and
defendants, as well as built one of the nations most preeminent Oil & Gas litigation practices.

* [Partnerships][4]
  * * * #### Alliance – Entrepreneur
        
        Our approach is unique and tailored to meet each entrepreneur’s specific vision. We
        undertake our Alliance engagements focused on helping each innovator bring the best possible
        product to market at an affordable cost with professionalism and integrity.
        
        [Learn More >][5]
    * * #### Alliance – Large Manufacturer
        
        Leaders and producers of medical devices experiencing challenges with market viability,
        commercialization, market access or growth can leverage our Alliance Program for a dedicated
        focus on an under-performing product or category.
        
        [Learn More >][6]
    * * #### Diversity & Inclusion
        
        SourceMark is one of the healthcare industry’s largest certified Minority Business
        Enterprises (MBEs) and can offer more adaptability, flexibility, and balance as compared to
        a non-MBE supplier.
        
        [Learn More >][7]
    * * #### Our Reach
        
        SourceMark is a recognized leader in offering innovative solutions as a master supplier for
        hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories,
        and physician offices throughout the United States.
        
        [Learn More >][8]
* [Products][9]
  * * * #### Anesthesia / Airway Management
        
        From our laryngoscopes to endotracheal tubes, and dynamic stylets, our portfolio of
        comprehensive solutions adds up to a powerful offering that brings innovation to patient
        care while improving outcomes.
        
        [Learn More >][10]
    * * #### Infection Prevention
        
        Our infection prevention solutions target vulnerable areas within the patient and clinician
        care continuum to create a care system where no person’s health and well-being is harmed by
        preventable infection.
        
        [Learn More >][11]
    * * #### Surgical
        
        SourceMark surgical products combine quality, reliability, safety and simplicity to advance
        patient care and clinician engagement through their ease-of-use, utilization efficiencies
        and affordable cost-point.
        
        [Learn More >][12]
    * * #### Fire and EMS
        
        [[Fire and EMS Professionals]][13]
        Explore our industry-leading airway management solutions designed to meet the demanding
        needs of emergency responders in any situation.
        
        [Learn More >][14]

# Production

**Independent. Integrated. Invested in Quality.**

Sterisets® International specializes in the production of high-quality, single-use medical
products—with a strong focus on increasing efficiency across the healthcare sector.

With three advanced production facilities in Europe, we operate independently and flexibly. This
allows us to maintain full control over both quality and costs.

We’ve made significant investments in:
* Skilled teams and quality assurance systems;
* Cutting-edge machinery, including injection molding, syringe filling and inspection, lamination,
  and packaging;
* Expanded facilities to support high-volume manufacturing.

Our vertically integrated production strategy ensures control over the entire supply chain—reducing
reliance on third-party suppliers and ensuring product consistency, cost-efficiency, and faster lead
times.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

## How can we help you?

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

[ Read more ][38]
[ Read more ][39]

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

[ Read more ][40]
[ Read more ][41]

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient
outcomes. This vital solution supports emergency teams by enhancing the efficiency and safety of
critical interventions, ultimately helping to save lives when every second counts.

[ Read more ][42]
[ Read more ][43]

### Bronchoscopy

Broncoflex offers advanced solutions for bronchoscopy with its innovative single-use bronchoscopes.
Designed for precision and ease of use, Broncoflex single use bronchoscopes provide high-quality
visualization and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. Ideal for both diagnostic and
therapeutic procedures, these reliable endoscopes enhance patient safety and efficiency in critical
care and surgical settings.

[ Read more ][44]
[ Read more ][45]

### Urology

In urology, using warmed irrigation fluid enhances patient comfort and maintains normothermia which
reduces the risk of hypothermia during procedures like TURP or cystoscopy. This solution not only
improves patient safety but also ensures smoother, more efficient procedures, especially late in the
list, leading to better overall results in urological care.
